svg.title: How Parc works: aim, release, open
svg.desc: Three steps on the left: 1 Aim, drag from the hub and a line follows your thumb across the arcs. 2 Release, let go over the app you want. 3 Open, it opens. On the right, a real screenshot of Parc's arc hub with the Glass skin; a line drags out from the hub to the Maps app, is released, and the app opens from its icon.
